description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment — windows on left and bottom facade(s). 1 double bedroom (no walk-in wardrobe, no en-suite), 1 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: unclear, no island. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: other. Largest bedroom accessed via corridor. 0 of 1 single bedroom(s) have a desk visible in plan. The single bedroom is large enough to accommodate a bunk bed for two children. Possible configurations — mutually exclusive: (1) all as children's bedrooms; (2) all as home offices or hobby rooms; (3) one or both as guest rooms; (4) bunk bed arrangement extending household capacity. Storage room adjacent to kitchen — usable as kitchen pantry, laundry room or general storage. From entry: kitchen is unclear, living area is unclear. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits: couples needing a spare room.
